acceptance: gc files no item for a branch whose net diff against HEAD is empty, proven through the real gc entry point
Every item that gc files about a branch is not lane-admissible in evolve wave supply
fix: Design first. (1) gc treats a branch as landed when its net content is already in HEAD (go/internal/gc/worktrees.go landingNoNet), so it files no item. (2) Each gc item about a branch carries the console route with the ref-state reason, because a lane cannot change ref state. A test through gc's real entry point pins both and is red without the change.

summary: The wave 166 boundary gc filed 13 gc-flag-unmerged-cycle-cd3ae73e-* items, 11 of them lane-eligible. Cycle 2332 claimed gc-flag-unmerged-cycle-cd3ae73e-2283; its audit failed it correctly: the acceptance is git ref state, and only a land or a console branch delete changes it. Each such item costs one lane cycle and a FAIL. The audit also found that HEAD already holds most of that branch's content.
